Consonantal i

Town, shops & places

restaurant noun

also eat out

classical

Traupman 174

caupōna, caupōnae f.

noun, first declension

inn, restaurant

Examples

  • in caupōnā parvā, exadversum cuppēdināriam sitā, prandērunt

    they had lunch in a little restaurant opposite a cake shopLibellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium

  • Haud procul ā summō hortō caupōna est parva, Rādīcēs nōmine

    Not far from the top of the garden there is a little café called RaízesLibellus III, Apud avum et aviam

  • Prīmum in caupōnā pittam prandērunt

    First they had pizza for lunch in a restaurantLibellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

Other words

  • popīna, popīnae f. — eating house, restaurant

    noun, first declension · also used · classical · L&S

See also café, waiter, serve, order, menu.

SourcesLewis & Short: caupona · Lewis & Short: popina
